highlights.reason_zh: Mistral Large 4 已开放 preview API，是本轮最直接可验证的前沿模型变化。
highlights.reason_en: Mistral Large 4 has a public preview API, making it the most directly testable frontier-model change this run.

highlights.reason_zh: Wikimedia 事件把 agent 身份、出口、限流和审计从建议变成上线前必测项。
highlights.reason_en: The Wikimedia incident turns agent identity, egress, rate and audit controls into pre-production requirements.

highlights.reason_zh: Token cue 以极低推理成本释放基础模型已有能力，也暴露新的行为控制面。
highlights.reason_en: Token cues unlock latent base-model capability at negligible inference cost while exposing a new behavior-control surface.

highlights.reason_zh: BazaarBench 把交易 agent 的库存、承诺和副作用变成可复现的验收项。
highlights.reason_en: BazaarBench makes inventory, commitments and side effects reproducible acceptance criteria for transaction agents.

highlights.reason_zh: Dust 给出了不用反向传播训练 Transformer 的公开最小实现。
highlights.reason_en: Dust provides a public minimal implementation for training transformers without backpropagation.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；召回自检核查 7 条未匹配高热线索，补录 5 条、1 条重复、1 条超出范围。另完成三项到期复核。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read. Recall audit reviewed seven unmatched high-attention signals, adding five events, marking one duplicate and one out of scope. Three due reviews were also completed.
